facts.title: Cheesy Smashed Broccoli
ingredients: 1 bunch of broccoli (about 1 ½ pounds) or 16 ounces broccoli florets
Scant ½ teaspoon fine salt, more to taste
2 ounces (¾ cup) finely grated Parmesan cheese
¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional, for a kick)
1 to 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
